title: Ekspedisi Trotoar Iseng
theme: Seorang individu yang awalnya enggan menemukan kegembiraan tak terduga dalam sebuah eksplorasi iseng di lingkungan sekitar, belajar menghargai hal-hal kecil dan keunikan yang tersembunyi.

cover.prompt: An indoor scene capturing a quiet, unhurried morning. A laptop sits prominently on a wooden desk, its screen showing text related to digital wellness. Beside it, a half-empty coffee cup. A smartphone rests nearby, displaying a clear notification from a delivery service. Soft, warm natural light streams in from an unseen window, creating gentle highlights and a sense of calm. The composition uses the rule of thirds, with a shallow depth of field gently blurring the background, focusing on the everyday objects. The overall atmosphere conveys a gentle procrastination and the quiet start to a day, before an unexpected interruption.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: A cynical freelancer is forced into an urban exploration due to a misdirected package and road closure, encountering absurdities that slowly shift his perspective from pure annoyance to a subtle appreciation for the strange details of everyday life, all while maintaining a sarcastic internal monologue.
